messages:
faye: Heads-up: Beacon Health is asking for tenant routing parity to start pilot. They want allowlist, per-route weights, deterministic fallback, and audit visibility.
omar: Do they expect a full policy engine or surface controls?
julia: SE summary: controls only (no DSL). Timeline = pilot in 3 weeks. Competitor pressure is real.
sam: Engineering take: scoped shim (weights + allowlist + fallback + logs) doable in ~3w with FF and canary. Full policy engine ~10w.
faye: Proposal: ship parity-shim for pilot, add per-tenant FF, include audit endpoint, and commit to scoped policy engine scoping in Q3. Launch criteria: p50 delta <=+20ms; audit logs include request_id, tenant_id, selected_model, fallback_chain; per-tenant rollback.
omar: Ops: need audit retention default (30d) + pipeline to analytics for longer retention. Per-tenant FF is required. Canary on dedicated pool.
julia: Commercial asks: written milestone for shim delivery + dated commitment to scoping the engine (non-binding for duration). Legal: keep commitments under 30d to avoid GC.
legal: note: any delivery promise >30d triggers additional review. Suggest "deliver shim by DATE" + "we will scope engine in Q3 and publish timeline after pilot" language.
sam: quick config example for shim: ```json
{"tenant":"beacon","allowlist":["rw-small","rw-medium"],"routes":[{"name":"default","weight":100,"fallback":["rw-small"]}],"audit":true}
```
faye: Decision: APPROVE parity-shim track with FF, audit visibility, canary, and commercial milestone email. Action items: @sam start spike+perf tests, @omar write milestone email, @julia prep pilot checklist + audit requirements, @ops-bot queue canary.
ops-bot: Canary plan queued: "beacon-parity/shim-rc1" -> beacon-only -> regional -> global.
sam: Spike started today; will post perf numbers in this thread by EOD Friday.
